note: Allocation is demand x supply. Demand from Pexels/Pixabay/Unsplash published popular-search lists (2026). Supply from Commons categoryinfo + a depth probe: recursion to depth 3 turned Category:Birds from 2 files into 158,325, so every root below is walked recursively, not read flat.

quality_gate.method: SigLIP prompt scoring at crawl time, same matmul as the safety score
drop: a scanned page of a book
a coat of arms or heraldic shield

buckets.name: Nature and landscape
buckets.demand: #1 on every published list: nature, landscape, forest, sunset, mountains, beach, sky, ocean, scenery, water

buckets.name: Animals and wildlife
buckets.demand: cat, dog, bird, butterfly, horse, elephant, lion, fish, wolf, cow, baby animal

buckets.name: Architecture and places
buckets.demand: cities, streets, buildings, bridges, interiors, plus heavy city-name searching (paris, new york, hamburg, glasgow, varanasi)

buckets.name: Art and illustration
buckets.demand: art, paintings, drawings, vintage, clipart, aesthetic
buckets.supply: Commons is a museum archive; outstanding here

buckets.name: Transport and vehicles
buckets.demand: car, airplane, train, ship, super car, bmw

buckets.name: Culture, religion and festivals
buckets.demand: very high and under-served elsewhere: krishna, shiva, ganesh, diwali, durga, islamic, mosque, kaaba, madina, christmas, jesus
buckets.supply: strong: temples, mosques, festivals, religious art

buckets.name: People and daily life
buckets.demand: people, couple, family, baby, portraits, office, doctor, gym
buckets.supply: WEAK. This is stock photography's home turf and Commons' blind spot. Allocation is deliberately below demand because the images are not there to take.

buckets.name: Science, space and technology
buckets.demand: space, universe, earth, brain, computer, ai
buckets.supply: strong; Commons carries NASA and ESA public-domain imagery

buckets.name: Textures, patterns and backgrounds
buckets.demand: ENORMOUS. Pixabay's list is dominated by wallpaper/background variants: 4k wallpaper, phone wallpaper, zoom background, marble background, wood texture
buckets.supply: WEAK on Commons, which does not shoot for this use. Under-allocated for the same reason as People.

buckets.name: Historical and archival
buckets.demand: vintage, black and white, retro, historical, old
buckets.supply: excellent and genuinely differentiating; nobody else has this

buckets.name: Quality images (flat, vetted)
buckets.demand: not a topic; a quality floor
buckets.supply: 462,631 files in ONE flat category, reviewed by Commons contributors for photographic quality. Highest signal-per-crawl available.
